function.name: geo_location_based_products_fetch_eco_friendly_products
function.description: Locate eco-friendly products near a specific geographic location based on product category and shopping preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: Your city or the geographical location you're interested in shopping from. e.g., Seattle, WA

product_category.description: The category of product that you're interested in. e.g., Yoga Mats, Bamboo toothbrush, etc

availability.description: Your preferred method of getting the product - Instore, Online, or Both.

message.reasoning: The user wants to find an in-store GMO yoga mat. They want a product that is GMO? Actually "GMO" stands for genetically modified organism. But maybe they mean "non-GMO"? The user says "尋找一個可以在店內購買的GMO瑜伽墊". That is Chinese: "Looking for a GMO yoga mat that can be purchased in-store." They want a product that is GMO? Usually yoga mats are not GMO. Maybe they want a yoga mat that is made from GMO materials? That seems odd. Perhaps they mean "non-GMO" but wrote "GMO". But we should follow the request: find a product that is GMO yoga mat available in-store. We need to use the function to locate eco-friendly products near a specific geographic location based on product category and shopping preferences. The function requires location, product_category, availability. We need to ask for location? The user didn't specify location. We can ask for location. Or we can assume a default? Better to ask for location. Also product_category: "Yoga Mats". Availability: "Instore". So we need to call the function with location unknown. We should ask for location.
